label: Surface Pro 9 (5G) tablet
description: Microsoft Surface Pro 9 (5G, SQ3) — 13-inch detachable Windows tablet, Wi-Fi 6E and 5G sub-6 GHz; USB-C Thunderbolt 4 and Surface Connect dock with Ethernet.
notes: Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5/6 GHz). Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz only (SQ3/ARM model — the Intel i5/i7 Surface Pro 9 is Wi-Fi only and should be modelled without wwan0); nano-SIM or eSIM. Ethernet arrives via the Surface Connect dock or a USB-C/Thunderbolt 4 adapter (usb0). Full Windows endpoint: supports WPA3-Enterprise, 802.1X and IPv6 privacy extensions, so use it where client-OS behaviour matters.
